crossRefs.note: Let him take his rod away from me. Let his terror not make me afraid;
withdraw your hand far from me, and don’t let your terror make me afraid.
Your fierce wrath has gone over me. Your terrors have cut me off.
For day and night your hand was heavy on me. My strength was sapped in the heat of summer.

translations.web: Behold, my terror will not make you afraid, neither will my pressure be heavy on you.
translations.bsb: Surely no fear of me should terrify you; nor will my hand be heavy upon you.
translations.kjv: Behold, my terror shall not make thee afraid, neither shall my hand be heavy
translations.asv: Behold, my terror shall not make thee afraid, Neither shall my pressure be heavy upon thee.
